prompt: A Ferris wheel makes $3.5$ complete rotations during one ride. Through how many degrees does a car turn? Give just the number.
explanation: One rotation is $360^\circ$, so 3 rotations are $1080^\circ$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Multiply straight through
steps: Rotations times degrees-per-rotation gives total degrees.
$3.5 \times 360 = 1260^\circ$ — and notice the car ends up half a turn from where it started, since $1260 - 1080 = 180$.
